name: ledger-panel-mock
description: Throwaway mock of four ledger panel options for #319: not in the marketplace, never writes a ledger

variant.title: Panel option
variant.description: pane: a pane on demand (this session). status: that pane plus a status line. band: a band row that opens a pane of every session. inline: a band row that expands in place (every session).

source.title: Ledger source
source.description: fixtures: the ledgers bundled with the mock. live: your own ledgers (~/.claude/session-ledger, or CLAUDE_SESSION_LEDGER_DIR), read only.
